name: Notification banner
summary: Use the Notification banner to tell users about an important change or the successful result of an action.
whenToUse: Use for important information that applies to the current page or for a success message after an action.
Put the banner after breadcrumbs or back link and before the main page heading.
whenNotToUse: Do not use for validation errors; use the Error summary and inline Error message.
Do not use instead of a confirmation page when the completed transaction needs a reference or durable record.

anatomy.name: Labelled region
anatomy.description: A region references the banner title with aria-labelledby.

anatomy.name: Banner title
anatomy.description: A compact heading identifies an important or successful notification.

anatomy.name: Content
anatomy.description: The content states the message and can include a relevant link.

variants.name: Important
variants.use: Important information that is not a success confirmation.

variants.name: Success
variants.use: Confirm a successful action on the next page.

behaviour: Initialise the govuk-notification-banner module; it manages focus for a success banner unless auto-focus is explicitly disabled.
Render important information as a region and success feedback as an alert using the official macro options.
The full message must remain available without client-side JavaScript.
accessibility: Give every banner title a unique id and reference it from aria-labelledby.
Use the success role and automatic focus sparingly so screen-reader users are notified without repeated interruptions.
Keep links descriptive and make meaning independent of colour.
content: Use “Important” for the default title and “Success” for a successful outcome unless a clearer short label is needed.
Lead with what changed or what the user completed.
Include only actions directly related to the notification.

htmlExamples.name: Important notification
htmlExamples.html:
Important

Your application deadline has changed.
